chapter: Buck and Bubbles: Nazarro and Bubbles
title: Nazarro teaches them to project and deliver lines
summary: Nazarro trained them for two years without performing, sometimes up all night on a single line, to teach projection like Buck and Bubbles.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: You didn't perform during those two years or you did?
What would he do, did he put you up in his house?
Yeah. We stayed there with him.
And he'd meet with you once a day and you'd go through your routine?
No, he'd like -- he trained us, you know. Some days we'd stay up all night. Saying one -- doing one line, you know.
You see, he was teaching us how to convey, like when you say a word, how to project.
See? Like he says, 'Hey boys, what you running for?' See, he was teaching us how to project, say talk, like Buck and Bubbles.
